name: Insomnia
overview: Scripture acknowledges that insomnia is a real experience, as seen in the unrest of King Ahasuerus and King Nebuchadnezzar, whose sleep fled from them during troubling times (Esther 6:1; Daniel 6:18). Yet the Bible also offers comfort, teaching that God grants peaceful and sweet sleep to His beloved, assuring safety and freedom from fear for those who trust in Him (Psalms 4:8; Proverbs 3:24; Psalms 127:2). This contrast highlights both the reality of sleeplessness in moments of distress and the divine provision of rest for those who call upon the Lord in truth (Psalms 145:18).
